policy: Company-team autonomous-driving technical reports selected from the five-track catalog. Require primary evidence of an official team report or company release; affiliations alone, individual/intern-led projects, sponsorships and backbone usage do not qualify. Do not infer internship or employment status. Dates are first arXiv submission dates, not media dates or revisions. Reuse catalog resource links and release status. Non-arXiv team reports use verified official release dates. Explicitly approved previews use company announcement dates and stay outside the paper catalog until a report is available. Documented series papers within the News window have separate rows with a series label.

coverage.note: No attributable driving research paper was verified for this initial selection. Business announcements and unrelated papers named MOMENTA were excluded. This is not an exhaustive publication audit.

The Article 39 FSD (Supervised) dashboard is regulatory safety evidence. The inspected sources did not establish a qualifying company driving-model research report.
